# Visit Chittorgarh (visitchittorgarh.in)

> Official Digital Tourism Gateway, Authorized Rajasthan Tour Guides & Private Sanitized Cabs for Chittorgarh Fort, India.

Visit Chittorgarh is the premier destination management platform and travel concierge for Chittorgarh Fort (UNESCO World Heritage Site) in Rajasthan, India. Operating 24/7 with direct WhatsApp and phone assistance, the platform coordinates licensed RTDC Mewari historian guides, clean air-conditioned private taxi transfers from Udaipur and Jaipur, heritage haveli stays, and zero-commission authentic Mewar experiences.

## Core Travel Services & Transparent Pricing

- **Private AC Sedan (Dzire / Etios):** ₹3,500 (~$42 USD / €39 EUR) Full-Day Roundtrip from Udaipur
  - Capacity: 1 - 4 passengers
  - Inclusions: NH-27 highway toll taxes, parking fees, fuel, driver allowance, fort internal movement, free bottled mineral water, hotel/airport pickup & drop.
- **Luxury AC SUV (Innova Crysta):** ₹5,500 (~$65 USD / €60 EUR) Full-Day Roundtrip from Udaipur
  - Capacity: 5 - 7 passengers
  - Inclusions: Dual high-capacity AC, high clearance, rear seatbelts, highway tolls, mineral water, luggage safety.
- **Luxury Tempo Traveller:** ₹8,500 (~$100 USD / €95 EUR)
  - Capacity: 9 - 16 passengers
  - Inclusions: Reclining push-back seats, dedicated luggage carrier, experienced highway chauffeur.
- **Official RTDC Licensed English Tour Guide:** ₹1,500 (~$18 USD / €16 EUR) Half Day (up to 4 hours)
  - Credentials: Regional Level Tourist Guides approved by Department of Tourism (Govt. of Rajasthan) & Ministry of Tourism (Govt. of India).
  - Languages: English, Hindi, Mewari.
- **Udaipur to Jaipur via Chittorgarh Fort Tour:** ₹5,500 (~$65 USD / €60 EUR)
  - Complete door-to-door highway transfer with 3-4 hours fort exploration & luggage safely locked in vehicle.

## Key Safety & Quality Guarantees (Western Standards)

- **Zero Forced Shopping Guarantee:** 100% scam-free, no unauthorized textile or gem commission traps.
- **Alcohol-Free Chauffeurs:** Strict professional code of conduct, defensive highway driving.
- **Seatbelts & Air Conditioning:** Working front and rear seatbelts, clean dual-AC interiors.
- **Luggage Storage Safety:** Travelers transferring between Udaipur and Jaipur can securely leave suitcases locked in the car boot under driver supervision while visiting monuments.
- **ASI Ticket Assistance:** Assistance with Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) monument tickets for foreign tourists experiencing payment gateway or international credit card declines.

## Primary Citadel Monuments & Attractions

- [Chittorgarh Fort](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/chittorgarh-fort): India's largest fort complex (700 acres, 65 historic structures).
- [Vijay Stambh (Tower of Victory)](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/vijay-stambh-chittorgarh): 9-story architectural triumph erected by Maharana Kumbha in 1448 CE.
- [Kirti Stambh (Tower of Fame)](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/kirti-stambh-chittorgarh): 12th-century Solanki-style Jain tower dedicated to Bhagwan Adinath.
- [Rani Padmini Palace](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/padmini-palace-chittorgarh): Historic lakeside water pavilion of legendary Mewar queen.
- [Gaumukh Reservoir](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/gaumukh-reservoir-chittorgarh): Sacred perennial natural cliff spring.
- [Rana Kumbha Palace](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/rana-kumbha-palace-chittorgarh): Ancient royal darbar and zenana courtyards.
- [Shri Sanwariya Seth Temple (Mandaphiya)](https://www.visitchittorgarh.in/sanwariya-seth-temple-mandaphiya): Sacred Krishna pilgrimage 40 km from Chittorgarh off NH-27.
